responsibility: Declares the Resolver2_0 top-level declaration collector and its glob-import helper for Rust name resolution. GlobbingVisitor describes how public items of a module are re-exported into shadowable namespace entries for use::* handling, while TopLevel defines the visitor that walks crate items to register top-level definitions, manage duplicate-name diagnostics and node-location tracking, remember forwarding created by use declarations, and provide helpers for ordinary, glob, and renamed imports before later Early and Late resolution passes consume those namespaces.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TopLevel and GlobbingVisitor classes, their visit hooks, and helper APIs for duplicate-checked insertion and use-declaration handling; the paired .cc file contains the concrete top-level collection, glob export, and import-resolution implementation.
